descricao: A signature animation piece built with AI: a small orbital system in SVG, animated with anime.js, where each body is one of the three things I deliver. Hover or Tab to a body to highlight what it stands for. The piece only loads when you get here, pauses off-screen, goes lighter on phones and stays still if your system asks for reduced motion.
rotuloDaPeca: Orbital system: three bodies circle a core on their own orbits, one for websites, one for automations and one for diagnostics.

pilares.texto: Fast, accessible, bilingual websites, from layout to deploy.
Workflows that take repetitive work off someone's hands.
A look at what exists today and what is worth changing first.
